title: Keep matching values
summary: F#: Keep matching values. Raise the limit to 9.
introduction: List.filter keeps values that pass a Boolean test. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Save each example as lesson.fsx and run dotnet fsi lesson.fsx.

blocks.title: Keep matching values
blocks.code:
let values = [4; 8; 9] |> List.filter (fun n -> n >= 7)
printfn "%A" values

blocks.text: The predicate is false for 4 but true for 8 and 9.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The test must return true or false.
